verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is itself a public HTTP API. Requests go to the r.jina.ai and s.jina.ai endpoints, and an extensive set of headers is documented with curl examples: x-respond-with, x-engine, x-max-tokens, x-json-schema, x-preset, POSTing files, and more. A code builder is offered for exploring parameter combinations, and community output shows the live API returning structured errors with auth via an Authorization header. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404) and an llms.txt for agent discovery (404).
